type: proposed full-permit ideal logic and explicit assumed counterexample; not transient simulation
inputs: proposed full qualification contract; resistor example refers to R1 latest official netlist

low_supply_example.interpretation: Plausibility calculation only; output and BJT behavior not guaranteed; no claim actual failure.

limits: The 64 cases evaluate only the desired DUMP_OFF request expression, not actual netlist or power flow; R1 UCC IN+=GUARD_OK and a low GUARD blocks actuation.
Guard 0 to valid, supervisor POR, reset assertion, analog switch power-up and partial rails are unmodeled.
Optocoupler VCE=0.2 V is an assumed operating point, not a CTR guarantee.
No BJT temperature/saturation, gate charge, wiring, or measured waveforms.
